description: The chart represents the token resolution breakdown for FedHLM, comparing the distribution of tokens across different categories. The pie chart is divided into three slices, representing "LOCAL", "EDGE_P2P", and "LLM". The "LOCAL" slice is the largest, colored green, and accounts for approximately 94.5% of the total. The "EDGE_P2P" slice is colored red and represents around 1.6% of the total. The "LLM" slice is colored blue and makes up about 3.9% of the total. The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, and the slices are labeled directly on the chart. The proportions of the slices are visually distinct, with "LOCAL" being the dominant category, followed by "LLM" and then "EDGE_P2P". The slices are not ordered in a particular way beyond their size.
